name: Wash
description:
Once per creature, per day: You touch a creature and choose one effect:

  • The creature regains HEART Endurance.

  • The creature's current Injury is halved.

  • The creature's Defense is restored to its base.

  • You end one lingering effect on the creature that was caused by an ability with an XP cost no greater than this ability.

Check a Condition. If the Condition you checked was Insecure, choose a second effect.
